description.value: Blenz Coffee is a BC-based specialty coffee chain founded in 1992, offering hand-crafted espresso drinks, organic whole-leaf teas, protein shakes, and a range of baked goods. The Penticton location is situated inside Cherry Lane Mall, making it a convenient indoor stop for cyclists moving through the South Okanagan. The brand emphasizes premium ingredients including 100% Arabica beans, single-origin chocolate, and organic matcha.
